name: hooksmith
description: Lifecycle-hook generator, linter, and verifier for Claude Code
author: Energy fleet

commands.name: generate
commands.description: Emit a hooks block for .claude/settings.json (auto-detects project type)

commands.name: lint
commands.description: Validate an existing hooks block, report violations (exits 1 on errors)

commands.name: verify
commands.description: Run a live probe to confirm PreToolUse + PostToolUse actually fire
